title: Cool Breeze Citrus Mist

diffuser.notes: Add to a cool-mist diffuser for a refreshing room atmosphere.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray lightly around the room.

why_it_works: Sweet orange uplifts with a sunny, cheerful note; peppermint adds a cooling, crisp edge; lavender softens and grounds, creating a balanced summer breeze.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
